2333.text: Everyone, man and woman, should acknowledge and accept his sexual identity. Physical, moral, and spiritual difference and complementarity are oriented toward the goods of marriage and the flourishing of family life. The harmony of the couple and of society depends in part on the way in which the complementarity, needs, and mutual support between the sexes are lived out.
2333.notes: Fetch showed 'the harmony' lowercase (page quirk); capitalized here. Ch 10, the father/mother paragraph after the four 'unity without' paragraphs.
